_doc: Monthly LIST prices (USD) of consumer subscription tiers, per provider.
These are DEFAULTS for `tatitok onboard`, not assertions: every value is
shown to the user, overridable at onboard time (--claude-price/--codex-price),
and editable in prices.json afterward (then `tatitok recompute --pricing`).
Prices are INPUTS, not code — this file mirrors the litellm price-snapshot
ceremony (internal/pricing/snapshot_meta.json): refreshing it is a deliberate
owner step, confirmed against the providers' public pricing pages.
free = no paid subscription priced at $0/mo (covers usage as plan_included $0);
for true pay-per-token usage choose 'metered' at onboard time (no plan written).
_source.note: Published consumer plan list prices as seeded; confirm at the source URLs when refreshing.
_source.2026-06-17_correction: OpenAI Pro split into two price points (both reported as plan_type="pro" in Codex logs): Pro $100 and Pro $200 — indistinguishable in the log, so they are a USER CHOICE (pro_100/pro_200), never guessed. Added the $8 Go tier. Anthropic re-verified unchanged.
